user.title: RAE Electricity Price
user.description: Track an electricity tariff from the RAE registry (energycost.gr). Choose the tariff category; the next steps list its providers and plans.

data_description.segment: Household or business tariffs of the RAE registry.
data_description.url: Leave the default to use the public data feed. A custom URL must point directly to the JSON feed, without redirects.

plan.title: Choose the plan
plan.description: Plans of {provider}, with the current standard price and, when different, the discounted price. Plans marked [withdrawn] are no longer sold, and plans marked [last listed] are missing from the newest month; existing customers may still be on them.

data_description.plan_filter: The plan name without its month-version ("My Home Online" covers "My Home Online 06.26", "07.26" and later).
data_description.discounted_price: The main price sensor (sensor.rae_price_single) shows the discounted price instead of the standard one. Separate Standard price and Discounted price sensors always show both.
